risk_note: RV2 (platform/redis, platform module, bootstrap, entry, packages/db testing). Lazy per-entry Redis handle (REDIS_URL via entry -> bootstrap -> PlatformModule, REDIS token; payout registers none): first command connects, connect failure or timeout fails that command with RedisUnavailableError and the next one retries; generation counter; TTL-required SET EX writes and EVAL with prefixed keys and TTL as ARGV[1] (sparse arrays refused); RedisClosedError extends RedisUnavailableError; idempotent close that never dials an unconnected handle and drops the client when QUIT fails. ioredis adapter: no reconnect / offline queue / resend / per-request retry / ready check; own handshake (SELECT must answer OK, PING must answer PONG, bounded by connectTimeoutMs, any error event fails it); query strings refused; no console. Secrets only in closures; fixed error messages without cause. acquireTestRedis: TEST_REDIS_URL with a RESP PING, else testcontainers redis:7.4.11-alpine noeviction. Legacy ledger (red run not required); rule tests by Codex, red confirmed in the container (77 tests, 6 files).
